value.name: Asha notices Daniel recognize the handwriting
value.description: Asha watches Daniel react with a small, specific stillness as he recognizes their mother's handwriting on the page.
evidence: Asha did not answer; she watched his eyes track the first visible line of their mother's handwriting and saw the small, specific stillness of a man recognizing something he had hoped was not in the house.

value.name: Asha asks if the handwriting looks familiar
value.description: Asha leans in and quietly asks Daniel whether the handwriting on the page looks familiar to him.
evidence: Asha leaned forward a fraction over the desk, kept her eyes on his, and asked in the same quiet register whether the hand on the page looked familiar to him.

value.name: Daniel inspects the folded pages
value.description: Daniel takes hold of the folded sheet and angles the writing into his own light without fully claiming it.
evidence: Daniel's fingers found the edge of the folded sheet before he seemed to decide they would, and he drew the pages a small distance toward himself, not enough to claim them, only enough to angle the writing into his own light.

value.name: Daniel checks the open door before responding
value.description: Daniel glances toward the open study door and empty hall, signaling caution and secrecy before returning his attention to the page.
evidence: His glance went once to the open study door and the empty hall, then back down

value.name: Daniel falls silent instead of answering
value.description: Daniel does not answer Asha's question, and his silence effectively admits the handwriting's identity.
evidence: He did not answer her question.
The silence that took its place was the kind that admitted the handwriting before his mouth was willing to.

value.name: Asha presses Daniel on when he last saw the letter
value.description: Asha keeps the silence going and asks Daniel when he last saw the folded sheet.
evidence: Asha did not break the silence; she watched Daniel's thumb and forefinger close on the edges of the folded sheet and asked, in the same low register she had used for the title line, when he had last seen this.

value.name: Daniel claims the pages
value.description: Daniel pulls the pages fully across the desk in a controlled motion that tries to appear casual.
evidence: He drew the pages the rest of the way across the wood then, claiming them in a single unhurried motion that tried to look like nothing

value.name: Daniel offers a thin smile
value.description: Daniel raises his face to Asha with a thin smile that does not reach the rest of him, suggesting discomfort or concealment.
evidence: when he raised his face to her he had assembled a thin smile that did not reach the rest of him.

value.name: Rosa arrives at the doorway with tea
value.description: Rosa comes to the study doorway carrying a tea tray and stops there, interrupting the private exchange.
evidence: Behind him, Rosa had come as far as the study doorway with the tea tray and stopped there
